messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the addition with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holds.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Converted to, unlesshas a float argument.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: The number is stored for addition to a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is added to the number in the right inlet, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number is added to the second number, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, adds that number to the number in the right inlet but nothing is sent out. A subsequentsends out the result.
